learning_outcomes.text: To furnish the basic notions of Linear Algebra and Euclidean Geometry.

syllabus_topics: Notions of trigonometry and analytic geometry
equations of lines, circumferences, ellipses, parabolas and hyperbole
Definitions and properties of the trigonometric functions
Vectors
Vector spaces: fields and vector spaces
Vector subspaces and affine subspaces
Linear independence, generators, bases
Linear functions and matrices: operations between matrices
Change of basis formulas
Kernel and image of a linear function
Theorem of the dimension
Properties of the determinant of a matrix
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Characteristic polynomial
Scalar product and norms: quadratic forms and associated matrices
Positive definite quadratic forms
Orthogonal vectors and matrices
Projections
Scalar product in Rn: basic properties and Cauchy-Schwarz inequality
Euclidean norm, basic properties and triangular inequalities
Systems of linear equations: matrix formulation and solutions
Rank and Rouché-Capelli theorem
Different methods for solving a linear system
teaching_methods: Lectures related to the theoretical topics of the course
Lectures on the exercises and on the solution of practical problems
assessment_rules: The exam aims to check knowledge and skills acquired with respect to the objectives of the course. It consists of a written exam (2 hours) concerning the main topics and an optional oral test concerning theoretical topics. The final grade, expressed out of thirty, will be composed on the basis of the degree of achievement of the previous requirements of the written and / or oral exam.
